verses.1: Do not walk in the way of Cain, who killed his brother who was innocent, while pretending to love his brother.
verses.2: And he killed his brother out of envy toward him; likewise do those who commit iniquity, envy, and deceit against their neighbor.
verses.3: They walked in the way of Cain and not in the innocent way of Abel, for Abel was innocent like a lamb, and his blood was like the innocent blood of a lamb that was offered to God with a pure heart.
verses.4: But those who walk in the innocent way of Abel, they truly love God, for they were innocent like Abel; indeed, everyone who walks in innocence, God loves him as He loved Abel the righteous and innocent.
verses.5: But as for the wicked, God will rebuke them, and a severe judgment is upon them in their distress; the book is in their hands, and they shall read it when judgment comes before the angels, and men, and all creation.
verses.6: Then the wicked and the sinners who did not do the will of God shall be put to shame.
verses.7: And a word of rebuke shall be given them, saying to them: Judgment is upon you in the judgment of the burning of fire, where there is no escape, forever.
